title: Give OLY-3-05 a mechanism: ten-dimension introspection coverage
summary: Add a pure function in athena-core introspect.rs that reports which of the ten feedback dimensions (observation, expectation, reproduction, immediate defect, scope, cause, escape, systemic implication, prevention, validation) an IntrospectionRecord fills, with a test. Record it as OLY-3-05's mechanism and a measure in docs/spec.toml. Audience: the spec verifier and maintainers reading docs/spec.toml.

defaults_applied.how: The new function has a passing test; fmt, clippy and test are acceptance criteria.
The test asserts the dimensions returned for specific records.
One function and one spec entry.
The requirement is tied to code via docs/spec.toml.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: I read crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs (IntrospectionRecord fields: what_happened, cause, prevention_kind, prevention, proposed_request, evidence, failure_class, earlier_cases, status), crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs (pub fns and its tests module at line 1673) and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (label table around line 302-312, which includes 'mistakes'). The change adds a function in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs and adds NO new record or data file and does not touch crates/athena-data/src/records.rs, so check_record_file and AnyRecord need no change; the existing round-trip tests of IntrospectionRecord keep covering the record unchanged. The property is measured directly: the function takes an IntrospectionRecord and returns the dimensions with non-empty content, and the test calls it on a full record and a sparse record.

Goal: OLY-3-05 gets a real mechanism and a measure ending in 'status: not shown' plus the test name, because no `athena status` line prints a per-dimension share; adding a status line is out of scope.

Mapping of dimensions to existing fields is my assumption: observation=what_happened, expectation/reproduction/scope=from evidence where present, immediate defect=category, cause=cause, escape=failure_class/earlier_cases, systemic implication=decisions_matched, prevention=prevention, validation=proposed_request. The producer may adjust the mapping if the fields read differently.
Consumers: none found for a new config key; no config file changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-3-05 has mechanism naming the new function by path (crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs), owner 'Athena' kept, and a measure that ends with 'status: not shown' and names the test; Grep of that function name finds it in introspect.rs.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`: the new test passes, asserting a full IntrospectionRecord yields all ten dimensions and a record with only what_happened yields only observation; the test fails if the function returns an empty or fixed set.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` from the repository root; all pass, including the existing spec-consistency test that checks mechanism paths and measure labels.
git diff shows no change to crates/athena-data/src/records.rs, athena.toml, defaults.toml, or any records/ path.

out_of_scope: Adding an `athena status` line that prints per-dimension coverage
Changing the introspection model prompt or the record schema
